note: North Dakota exempts personal property from property tax except property of centrally assessed entities (such as utilities) and property taxed under another law (such as mobile homes), so there is no county business personal property return. Other county-level business duties, such as lodging occupancy taxes, licenses or clerk filings, were not checked.
